system.description:
LEVEL 3

Armor Master. You are proficient with plate armor.

Shield Expert. While equipped with a shield you can Defend for free; when you do, you may deal damage to an adjacent enemy equal to your shield's armor.

LEVEL 7

Juggernaut. When you use Coordinated Strike, you can spend an additional action to add 1 to your Primary Die and deal extra damage equal to your armor.

LEVEL 11

Taunting Strike. (1/turn) You may Taunt a creature you attack until the end of their next turn.

LEVEL 15

Shield Wall. (Reach 2) Your shields gain +2 armor. Your allies can also use your shield's armor when they Defend.
